status_definitions.validated_engineering: Deterministic implementation claim supported by tests or a controlled gate.
status_definitions.candidate_automated: Completed automated research evidence with explicit validity limits; not independently human validated.
status_definitions.not_established: The current study cannot support this claim.
status_definitions.superseded: Historical artifact retained only for forensic comparison and not citable as current evidence.
status_definitions.withdrawn: A previously reported claim that was found to be circular or otherwise unsound and has been retracted. Retained here so the retraction is discoverable.

artifact_policy.current_results: Only entries in this registry and the comprehensive 2026-08-03 report are current evidence.
artifact_policy.row_level_requirement: Every reported aggregate must be reproducible from saved row-level predictions.
artifact_policy.error_policy: Execution errors remain unscored and visible; they are never replaced by a default prediction.
artifact_policy.legacy_outputs: Older output directories are superseded even when retained on disk.
artifact_policy.superseded_gold: Artifacts scored under the declaration-coupled gold (files named *_authoritative*) are retained on disk for forensic comparison but are not current evidence. Any table showing a flat 0.0 false-contradiction rate for a system named plain `declared`, or a 1.000 macro-F1, comes from those files and is withdrawn.

entries.scope: Deterministic inputs, three deletion seeds, random/clustered modes, logged triples, companion declarations, and file hashes.

entries.result: 183 tests pass (101 previous, 36 covering declaration-independent gold including the set-relation depletion regression, 20 covering multi-vendor model parameter compatibility, 12 covering the retrieval baseline, and 13 covering the panel analysis including the abstention-quality metrics that expose an indiscriminate abstainer); NUSMods 0.3476 and CoDEx 0.2953 shuffled prediction-change rates both pass the 0.20 gate; RMIT shuffle/empty accuracy drops are 0.424/0.515; the rescore reports 5 residual gold anomalies across 61,164 scored rows, all from one multi-hop triple.

On contradiction rate against claims true in the reference world, random deletion at 20% retention: declared_stale and binary are identical in all four generator/detector pairings (Azure->Azure 0.664 [0.628, 0.701]; Azure->Gemma 0.705; Gemma->Azure 0.739; Gemma->Gemma 0.761), rising from 0.000 at full retention. Stale completeness metadata is therefore indistinguishable from no metadata at all. declared_oracle holds 0.000 by construction; at random 20% it scores 0.990 accuracy, 0.919 macro-F1, 1.000 Contradicted recall at 0.619 precision, and 0.317 decision coverage - its cost is coverage, not missed contradictions. Occupancy is non-monotonic: at threshold 0.50 harm rises to 0.205 at 50% retention then falls to 0.000 at 20% purely because the density crosses the threshold. Oracle and extracted-atom Stage 4 accuracy remain 1.0. Gold anomalies across 61,164 rows: 5, all from one multi-hop triple.
entries.validity_limit: Gold is independent of every system under test but is still derived from graph contents rather than human judgement; declared_oracle cannot lose on the safety metric by construction and is a ceiling; questions and declarations are researcher-derived; one stochastic answer run per generator condition.
entries.withdrawn_claim: The previous entry reported binary FCR 0.963-0.991 at 20% retention against declared FCR 0. Both figures were artifacts of a gold function coupled to the declaration file, plus a `binary` arm that was one line of post-processing on the `declared` output. 1105/1147 = 0.963 reproduced the reported value exactly, showing the curve restated the deletion rate. A second claim was also withdrawn during this revision: that declared_oracle over-abstains, recovering only 0.142 of detectable contradictions. That figure came from a set-relation bug in the replacement gold which read depleted member lists as authoritative; actual contradiction recall is 0.946-1.000.

entries.result: These arms carry the most weight because the predictor has no connection to the gold definition. Contradiction rate on true claims, random 100% -> 20% retention: Azure tri-state 0.000 -> 0.254; Azure binary collapse 0.000 -> 0.685; Gemma tri-state 0.109 -> 0.670; Gemma binary collapse 0.138 -> 0.757; MiniCheck mapped 0.225 -> 0.808. Tri-state prompting with oracle evidence therefore reduces the harm 2.7x for Azure but only 1.13x for Gemma, and never eliminates it. Azure tri-state accuracy falls 0.920 -> 0.643 while its false-support rate rises 0.080 -> 0.333, so the failure is not mere over-caution. MiniCheck native binary accuracy rises 0.713 -> 0.833 as facts are deleted while its tri-state accuracy collapses to 0.170, evidence that label space rather than model quality is the binding constraint. Title-only NIL linking remains a major limitation at 0.572 total accuracy.
entries.validity_limit: Flat context is selected from known expected triples and is not an end-to-end retriever, so these numbers are an upper bound on retrieval-based deployment. Model predictions are unchanged from the original runs; only the gold column was recomputed (130 of 3,000 rows changed per file, with the previous label retained as gold_previous_declaration_coupled).

entries.result: Full-context expected-triple F1 is 0.788 Azure and 0.678 Gemma; random 20% binary FCR is 0.953/0.987 and declared FCR is 0 under mechanical labels.
entries.validity_limit: RMIT contains 50 graph entities and 50 long-form questions.

entries.result: Random-sample Azure/Gemma accuracy is 0.998/0.994 on NUSMods, 0.848/0.798 on CoDEx, and 0.604/0.590 on FactKG; full RMIT accuracy is 0.970/0.750. All cells have zero harness failures.
entries.validity_limit: FactKG is forced binary and ordered by reasoning type; RMIT public claims remain synthetic; public intervals are row-level rather than entity-clustered. Four earlier Azure CoDEx/FactKG cells predate start-time hash capture; all local cells and affected Azure NUSMods/RMIT reruns contain code identity.

entries.scope: 15 models across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta, nano to frontier, on the oracle-context tri-state verifier arm. 18,000 classifications, of which 17,993 produced a prediction. Identical claims, evidence, prompt and declaration-independent gold; only the model varies.
entries.result: A third label is necessary but not sufficient. Binary-collapse contradiction rate on true claims is 0.681-0.739 across all 15 models - a 0.058 spread over a 10x capability range - so the binary failure is a property of the task rather than the model. Tri-state harm spans 0.051-0.540 (best gpt-5.4-nano 0.051 [0.008, 0.108]; median 0.243; 14 of 15 above 0.11), so no model reaches zero. The failure mode is uniformly under-abstention: abstention precision is 0.972-1.000 for every model while abstention recall spans 0.267-0.933. Capability is a weak predictor: Spearman(competence, harm) = -0.662, but within-tier spread (0.489 in the small tier) is about four times the between-tier spread (0.132), and the ordering is non-monotonic inside every vendor - gpt-5.4-nano, the smallest model in its family, beats frontier gpt-5.5 fourfold. Vendor means: OpenAI 0.217, Anthropic 0.273, Meta 0.326, Google 0.381.
entries.validity_limit: Evidence is oracle-selected, so these are upper bounds on retrieval-based deployment (see retrieval_recall_bound). Six of fifteen models - azure-o3, claude-opus-4-7, gpt-5.4, gpt-5.4-mini, gpt-5.4-nano, gpt-5.5 - reject temperature=0 and ran at a provider default; they span best to mid-pack and the worst model overall ran at temperature 0, so sampling does not explain the ordering, but cross-vendor comparison through a single gateway is a real limitation. One seed, random deletion mode only, retentions 100/80/50/20. Tier and vendor labels are editorial and recorded in the artifact. Seven rows (0.04%), all gemini-2.5-flash JSON truncations across 5 unique triples, produced no prediction; they are excluded from scoring and never defaulted, leaving that model's cells at n=295-300 rather than 300.

entries.scope: Okapi BM25 over all 11,647 NUSMods records with stopword removal and exact course-code promotion, plus an optional all-MiniLM-L6-v2 dense rerank. Deterministic, no model calls.
entries.result: The oracle-context arm assumes recall@1 = 1.0 with perfect relation selection. A real retriever achieves 0.880 at rank 1 on code-bearing queries (0.980 at rank 10) and 0.470 on title-only queries (0.855 at rank 10). Oracle context therefore overstates available evidence by about 12 points at rank 1 when an identifier is present and about 53 points when it is not. The dense rerank does not help (0.865 / 0.440 at rank 1), a negative result retained rather than dropped.
entries.validity_limit: Measures subject-record retrieval only; the oracle arm also assumes perfect relation selection within the record, which is not measured here. Title-only queries are a constructed rewrite, not naturally occurring user text.

entries.supported_claim: A controlled measurement study of how post-hoc factuality verification degrades under knowledge-graph incompleteness. (a) Across 15 models and four vendors, a tri-state label space is necessary but not sufficient: binary-collapse harm is 0.681-0.739 regardless of model while tri-state harm spans 0.051-0.540 and no model reaches zero. (b) The failure mode is uniformly under-abstention - abstention precision 0.972-1.000 for every model, all variation in recall. (c) Correct abstention does not track capability: within-tier spread is about four times the between-tier spread and the ordering is non-monotonic inside every vendor. (d) Stale completeness metadata is indistinguishable from no metadata on the safety metric. (e) Decomposition rather than symbolic lookup dominates the end-to-end error budget. Supporting negative results: occupancy inference is non-monotonic and threshold-fragile, binary checkers have a label-space defect, dense reranking does not beat tuned BM25 on short catalogue records, and oracle context overstates retrieval by 12-53 points at rank 1.
not_established: independently validated real-world factuality accuracy (gold is mechanical, not human-annotated)
end-to-end retrieval-based verification performance (the panel uses oracle-selected evidence; retrieval recall is measured separately but the two were not composed)
broad generalization beyond catalogue schemas and two public benchmarks
that the panel ordering is free of sampling effects (6 of 15 models ignored temperature=0)
entries.framing: Measurement paper, not a systems paper. A systems framing would be judged on beating the FActScore/SAFE/VeriScore lineage, which this work does not attempt.
entries.withdrawn_claim: Explicit relation completeness metadata implements consistent tri-state semantics with a zero false-contradiction rate. Withdrawn: that result was entailed by a gold function that read the same declaration file as the system it scored.

venue_readiness.full_conference: reachable in roughly 6-8 weeks with human-validated gold and a real retriever

next_steps_ranked: Human-validated gold on 300 stratified claims, two annotators, report Cohen kappa.
Compose the measured retriever with the verifier to get an end-to-end number, rather than reporting oracle-context and retrieval recall separately.
Repeat the panel at several temperatures to separate sampling from capability for the six models that ignore temperature=0.
Three or more answer-generation runs per generator/condition to cover LLM sampling variance.
Test whether fact-level or entity-level declarations recover the coverage that relation-level flags cost; this is an open question, not a demonstrated defect.
A naturally incomplete graph, e.g. a time-sliced NUSMods snapshot pair.
Scale the question set to roughly 1,000; do this last because it costs compute, not design.

human_validation.consequence: Research entries remain candidate_automated and cannot support an independent efficacy or journal-ready claim.

superseded_policy: All registry-v1 studies, dated pilots, draft papers, and duplicate status documents are superseded and recoverable through Git history.

gold_definition.why: The previous gold read the same completeness declaration as the proposed `declared` routing mode, so the system was graded against its own rule and scored exactly 1.000 accuracy and 1.000 macro-F1 in all 336 cells with a zero-width bootstrap interval. Gold is now a function of graph contents only, and a declaration is purely a system input that can be fresh, stale or absent.
gold_definition.headline_metric_note: Of claims true in the reference world, the fraction the system called Contradicted. Needs no convention about how absence should be labelled. false_contradiction_rate is retained only for comparability with prior work.
gold_definition.ceiling_arm_caveat: declared_oracle receives a declaration regenerated for the exact damage applied, so it cannot emit a contradiction from absence. Its zero is definitional and is reported as a ceiling, never as a result.
gold_definition.set_relation_note: Random deletion removes individual members of set-valued relations and leaves the container in place. Absence of a claimed member licenses a contradiction only when the visible member set is provably identical to the reference member set. An earlier revision omitted this and mislabelled 230 of 296 supposed contradictions in one cell.
